question: In Table 1 (Page 5), what scores did GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 achieve across the three Sommelier theory knowledge exams (Introductory, Certified, Advanced) and on LeetCode (Easy, Medium, Hard at k=1)?
expected_answer: In Table 1 (Page 5), on Sommelier theory knowledge, GPT-4 vs GPT-3.5 achieved 92% vs 80% (Introductory), 86% vs 58% (Certified), and 77% vs 46% (Advanced). On LeetCode (k=1, out of 41 Easy, 39 Medium, 20 Hard), GPT-4 solved 31/41 Easy, 21/39 Medium, and 3/20 Hard, compared to GPT-3.5 with 12/41 Easy, 8/39 Medium, and 0/20 Hard.

gold.evidence: Introductory Sommelier: GPT-4 = 92%; GPT-3.5 = 80%. Certified Sommelier: GPT-4 = 86%; GPT-3.5 = 58%. Advanced Sommelier: GPT-4 = 77%; GPT-3.5 = 46%. LeetCode: GPT-4 (k=1) = 31/41, 21/39, 3/20; GPT-3.5 (k=1) = 12/41, 8/39, 0/20.
gold.unit_and_condition: Sommelier percentages and LeetCode k=1 pass counts out of 41/39/20.

[CHART: System Card Figure 11 | Page 98 | BBox (55, 90, 555, 520)]
- Figure 11 Caption: 'Results on IF (Instruction Following) evaluations across GPT3.5, GPT3.5-Turbo, GPT-4-launch'.
- Indexing note: Embedded raster image (imgs=1) on page 98 with 82 characters of vector caption text; shows GPT-4-launch achieving the highest instruction-following score across all evaluated categories compared to GPT-3.5 and GPT-3.5-Turbo.

[CHART: Figure 4 | Page 6 | BBox (45, 55, 565, 430)]
- Figure 4 Title: Exam results (ordered by GPT-3.5 performance) — GPT performance on academic and professional exams.
- X-axis: Exams ordered from low to high based on GPT-3.5 performance (from AP Calculus BC, AMC 12, Codeforces Rating up to SAT EBRW, AP Environmental Science).
- Y-axis: Estimated percentile lower bound among test takers (0% to 100%). Legend: gpt-4 (dark green), gpt-4 no vision (light green), gpt3.5 (blue).
- Artifact explanation in caption: Reporting the conservative lower bound of percentile bins creates artifacts on AP exams with wide scoring bins — for example, although GPT-4 attains the highest possible score on AP Biology (5/5), it is shown in the plot as 85th percentile because 15% of test-takers achieve a 5.

[CHART: Figure 5 | Page 8 | BBox (45, 55, 565, 450)]
- Figure 5 Title: GPT-4 3-shot accuracy on MMLU across languages (translated MMLU suite of 26 languages).
- Y-axis: Accuracy (0% to 90%).
- Baseline bars (English): Random guessing = 25.0%, Chinchilla-English = 67.0%, PaLM-English = 69.3%, GPT-3.5-English = 70.1%, GPT-4 English = 85.5%.
- GPT-4 3-shot language scores (high to low): Italian = 84.1%, Afrikaans = 84.1%, Spanish = 84.0%, German = 83.7%, French = 83.6%, Indonesian = 83.1%, Russian = 82.7%, Polish = 82.1%, Ukrainian = 81.9%, Greek = 81.4%, Latvian = 80.9%, Mandarin = 80.1%, Arabic = 80.0%, Turkish = 80.0%, Japanese = 79.9%, Swahili = 78.5%, Welsh = 77.5%, Korean = 77.0%, Icelandic = 76.5%, Bengali = 73.2%, Urdu = 72.6%, Nepali = 72.2%, Thai = 71.8%, Punjabi = 71.4%, Marathi = 66.7%, Telugu = 62.0%.
- Key finding: GPT-4 outperforms GPT-3.5 English (70.1%) in 24 out of 26 languages tested (including Latvian 80.9%, Swahili 78.5%, Welsh 77.5%), with only Marathi (66.7%) and Telugu (62.0%) below 70.1%.
